thread:
Megan: Newbridge sent their RFI + security workbook. They need a short RFI pack: capability matrix, POC scope, and clarified pricing for Dedicated vs Private (on-prem HSM). Major blockers: SSO, HSM integration, and low-latency SLA. Can we deliver by EOD Wed?
Arjun: I'll draft the capability matrix and two-tier pricing. Carmen, can you own HSM/KMS wording and include KMIP notes? Ryan, add fallback/quantization notes.
Carmen: Draft HSM blurb below and will upload KMIP integration doc to the drive.
```
HSM / KMS (draft):
- Private: customer-managed on-prem HSM via KMIP; Redwood provides KMIP proxy + PKCS#11 connectors.
- Dedicated: BYO HSM supported via peered VPC; Redwood terminates TLS, key material stays in customer HSM.
- Hosted: managed KMS with envelope encryption; optional HSM-backed keys under Enterprise add-on.
- Audit: key ops emit audit events and can stream to S3/ELK/CloudWatch for SIEM.
```
Devon: Suggested POC plan (3 weeks): Week 0 NDAs + network preflight; Week 1 infra + baseline tests; Week 2 perf runs (50-200 qps), cache tuning; Week 3 review + handoff + SOW snippet.
SecurityBot: Uploaded Newbridge_Security_Q_2026.xlsx to Drives: https://drive.redwood/internal/newbridge/RFI.
Arjun: CSV matrix stub: feature,hosted,dedicated,private; SLA,99.9%,99.95%,customer-defined; HSM,managed KMS,BYO HSM,on-prem via KMIP; SSO,Yes,Yes,Yes; Latency,~40-80ms,~30-60ms,depends on infra.
Ryan: Add technical fallback: Dedicated pool can automatically route to compatible quantized variant or opt-in hosted pool during degradation. Call out KV prefix caching to reduce token usage.
Carmen: Contract note: For EU customers, processing and logs remain in EU regions; private installs stay within customer network.
Megan: I'll assemble the zip (capability_matrix.csv, security_answers.docx, poc_timeline.md, sample_SOW.pdf) and upload to the Newbridge drive. Devon please review the SOW in 30m.
Devon: Will do.
Megan: Thx — ping in-thread or DM for urgent follow-ups.
